claim: Redacts selected headers and JSON fields before disk
sandbox: fresh temp folder and local upstream; send an HTTP request through the capture sidecar; inspect the only saved exchange for redaction markers and absence of request and response secrets

claim: Mock servers and webhook sends accept loopback targets only
sandbox: run the CLI against a non-loopback bind and target; then send every standard redirect status from a loopback first hop to a second receiver; assert neither capture nor signed webhook traffic reaches the redirected destination

claim: An exported fixture matches its recorded method and path and returns the recorded response locally
sandbox: fresh CLI demo bundle; start the mock on loopback; POST to the recorded path; assert status 503 and the recorded JSON body

claim: A scrubbed webhook is re-signed with a local secret before it is sent
sandbox: fresh CLI demo bundle and local receiver; send with a test environment secret; assert a fresh HMAC signature and no captured signature

claim: The browser demo uses sample data, stores only demo-prefixed session state, and makes no third-party request
sandbox: fresh browser context; record requests and storage while opening and resetting /demo

claim: The CLI demo never reads or changes an existing capture folder
sandbox: create an existing captures/payment-webhook.json with private content; run demo --out against its parent; assert the command refuses and the file is byte-for-byte unchanged

claim: Boundary Replay sends no telemetry during its local demo flow
sandbox: fresh browser context records all requests while visiting the landing page and demo; run the shipped CLI demo; assert browser requests remain same-origin and the CLI demo completes without network configuration

claim: The browser demo works offline after the first visit
sandbox: fresh browser context; visit /demo; wait for service worker control; go offline; reload and inspect the fixture

claim: The browser demo exports one scrubbed sample fixture
sandbox: fresh browser context; download the demo bundle; assert its manifest, count, status, and redaction markers

claim: The local exporter is free to use
sandbox: fresh browser context; open the demo, export its bundle, and inspect the downloaded fixture
